name: The Hall of Thanes
location: Ironforge: from the Great Forge face the High Seat, take the web-covered passage on the left (43.5, 52.0) and follow it down
strategy: Faldrim Anvilmar: clear the ghosts around the tomb first; dispel Anvilmar's Curse from the tank (-20% attack and cast speed); interrupting Mind Blast is optional
Magmatus: kill the Dark Iron Summoner first; ranged stay back from his fire pulses, and healers watch all melee
Plunder: tank him with your back to a wall so his knockback is safe; pull him away from other mobs
Durgen Dirgehammer: clear the room first because his AoE fear scatters the group; kill his two Lesser Stone Golems first; Tremor Totem helps
tips: The city sits on lava: falling in is lethal
Shoot the Seaforium Blasting Powder kegs from range before engaging nearby packs
Bloodhound Runts' Infected Wounds raise physical damage taken: cure disease, Simple Poultice or Stoneform
Horde can run it, but entry is awkward and there are no Horde quests

name: Ruins of Lordaeron
location: Just outside Undercity: up the stairs on the left after the front gate, before the keep (Tirisfal 72.4, 11.6)
strategy: Witherfang: doesn't social-aggro, so pull her alone from range; kill Broodlings first
The Baron: tank against a wall (stun knockback); ranged spread out; be ready to kite if he switches target
Viktor the Vile: top up mana before lighting the fireplace: five waves of adds come first; then tank and spank
The Abandoned: interrupt Drain Life on the tank; fight through Frost Nova after three add waves; start full mana
Bjork: tank and spank; switch to physical damage while his Anti-Magic Shield is up
Rath'mael: interrupt or move melee away from the Flamestrike aimed at the tank, then reposition
Lordaeron Captain (rare, west side): tank and spank; Horde only
tips: Cure Ghoul Plague immediately (30-min slow and damage loss)
Dispel Frost Armor on Skeletal Mages
Use magic on Stone Watchers during Stone Slumber
Alliance: run out rather than hearth, to hand the Head of the Baron to Captain Truman

name: Excavation Site: Wetlands
location: Wetlands: winding path left of Thelgen Rock from about 53.9, 65.4; entrance at 48.1, 56.5
strategy: Saltspine: clear a dry arena first; ranged and healers stay out of the sandstorm (accuracy debuff)
Shadetooth: clear the reed raptors (they call for help); dispel the AoE fear fast; save defensives for the low-health enrage
Highland Horror: pull it away from the slimes; leave its root area at once; interrupt its self-heal
Relic Guardian: activate at the Archival Panel beside the column on the right; don't tank near the edge (knockback)
tips: Bring disease cures: Infected Wounds, Muculent Rot and Highland Venom
Horde need Dragonmaw Rumors (Zaruk, Arathi Highlands) before Open the Maw
Tremor Totem helps against Shadetooth
Raptor bleeds can kill squishies fast

name: City of Dalaran
location: Silverpine Forest sewer entrance at 69.3, 45.6 (the city itself is in Alterac Mountains). Alliance usually set out from Southshore; Horde from the Sepulcher
strategy: Atrexis the Grave Knight: clear around him without pulling; tank his skeletons; heal or purge Unholy Frenzy
Lyn the Ignored (secret boss, needs a Tome of Dalaran): tank his skeletons; remove Curse of Thorns
Mana Devourer: clear Violet Hold first; a healing check against Drain Vitality and Debilitate
Arcane Anomaly: stack tightly behind it to dodge the rotating Focal Blast beam
Fel Ancient: talk to Magus Fansy Goodbringer in Runeweaver Square to drop the barrier; break roots and avoid Fel Timbers pools
Arcanic Enigma: kill both Mana Phantoms (Mana Burn) first; ranged stay away from its polymorph and AoE silence
Unstable Sentry: spread out; melee leave when it casts Malfunction
Shade of the Archmage: ranged spread and dodge Bounding Mana; break Mass Polymorph when it runs out of mana
tips: Tremor Totem stops Mindless Horrors' fear chain-pulls
Completing Heart of Disruption unlocks the open-world Dalaran and makes guards friendly to Horde
A locked door after the first bridge leads straight to the Violet Citadel, skipping most of the dungeon

name: The Drowned City
location: Off the Stranglethorn coast, underwater at about 21.4, 27.9: swim past the Vile Reef to the Sunken Hollow by the water-elemental island
tips: Known bosses so far: Zul'Alai, Zin'aka, Var'Taka and Captain Dreadrise (from the BlizzCon demo; probably more)

name: Krol'dok Stronghold
location: Riverglades: on the hill above Sunnyglade; enter via the cave west of the fortress gates (37.5, 37.5)
tips: Datamined keys: Krol'dok Compound Key and Krol'dok Ogre Key
The route climbs between huts and over a big wooden bridge to the top buildings
Overlord Mugg is a named boss (Legacy challenge)

name: Alcaz Prison
location: Alcaz Island off Dustwallow Marsh: portal in the basement of the large building around 75, 15, via the hill path left of the dock
tips: Blazeroar is a named boss (Legacy challenge)
No quests were known before launch

name: Blackmaw Hold
location: Azshara furbolg tunnel at 38.7, 33.4; the portal is deep inside (Winterspring map 66.6, 84.4)
tips: Varrox Bleakhoof is a named boss (Legacy challenge)
Blackmaw Pouches appear to give Blackmaw tribe reputation
Blackmaw Ritual Totem is a datamined quest item

name: Shaper's Terrace
location: Un'Goro Crater: hill above Marshal's Refuge at 48.1, 6.1
tips: Named bosses: Bolt, Cinder, Snowtalon and Nanaya (probably more)
Bring Un'Goro power crystals (blue, green, red, yellow) to use at consoles inside
A raid portal is rumoured behind a closed gate near the waterfall

name: Barrow Deeps
location: Mount Hyjal (two more entrances not yet announced)
tips: Raids open 9 December 2026
Attunement: to be announced

tips: Raids open 9 December 2026
